spanish: Todos los días de su ser desolada cesará, lo que no cesó en sus shabatot en su habitar ustedes sobre ella.

findings.issue: כל־ימי is the time span; תשבת is qal imperfect 3fs, so a feminine singular subject ceases. The Spanish makes the plural días the one that cesará.
findings.spanishSpan: Todos los días de su ser desolada cesará

findings.issue: את marks אשר as the object, and שבתה is qal perfect 3fs (she did not cease it). lo que is the subject of cesó.
H7676 is a common noun with preposition ב and 2mp suffix. shabatot leaves that noun untranslated.
Hophal infinitive construct plus 3fs suffix is smoothed to the state ser desolada; causative-passive force is not explicit.

notes: sobre ella matches עליה; su habitar ustedes keeps the 2mp suffix on the H3427 infinitive.
